topic: impact of AI agents on developer workflows

summary.title: How AI Agents Are Revolutionizing Software Development Workflows
keyPoints: AI agents are automating routine coding tasks and implementation, shifting developers' primary work from writing code to writing prompts, reviewing output, and making judgment calls.
Research from JetBrains shows AI tools are reshaping developer workflows in ways that often elude developers' own perceptions, with context awareness proving more important than clever prompting.

AI agents boost productivity by explaining code, improving documentation, and guiding troubleshooting, but their effectiveness is amplified by developer platforms and psychological safety for responsible experimentation.
summary.takeaway: AI agents are transforming software development by automating implementation and reshaping developer roles toward oversight, context gathering, and higher-level decision-making, with success depending on strong context and supportive platforms.
